CVCRD01Y defines CC-ACCT-ID / CC-ACCT-ID-N inside record CC-WORK-AREAS. INITIALIZE CC-WORK-AREA (line 500) initialises only the sub-group CC-WORK-AREA, not CC-ACCT-ID directly; neither CC-ACCT-ID nor CC-ACCT-ID-N appears as an exact token in any procedure. COCOM01Y defines CDEMO-ACCT-ID: zero occurrences as an exact token in procedures. CVACT02Y defines CARD-ACCT-ID inside CARD-RECORD: CARD-RECORD is never referenced anywhere in the file (confirmed by grep). All three copybooks are effectively dead imports for the ACCT-ID lineage.

hits.note: After a successful CICS READ INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD (line 400), ACCT-ID is extracted and placed into WS-ACCT-ID, which is then included in the MQ reply message sent back to the requesting system (via WS-ACCT-RESPONSE MOVE to REPLY-MESSAGE at line 426).

programs.notes: ACCOUNT-RECORD (from CVACT01Y) is read via EXEC CICS READ INTO (ACCOUNT-RECORD) at line 400. ACCT-ID is then individually named on line 408 as the first field extracted from the record. This program serves as an MQ-based account inquiry service: it receives an account key via MQ, reads the VSAM file, and puts key account fields including ACCT-ID into a reply message.
